parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

> Call [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the destination region.

parameters.name: ElasticDailyPlanDay
parameters.description: The start date of the daily scaling plan. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

parameters.name: ElasticDailyPlanStatusList
parameters.description:
The execution status of the daily scaling plan. To query multiple statuses, separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

- **1**: Not executed.

- **2**: Executing.

- **3**: Succeeded.

- **4**: Failed.

parameters.name: ElasticPlanName
parameters.description:
The name of the scaling plan. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It must be 2 to 30 characters in length.

- It must consist of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

parameters.name: ResourcePoolName
parameters.description:
The name of the resource group.

> Call [DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~466685~~) to query the name of the resource group.
